title: *5 MINUTE* CHOCOLATE TIFFIN CAKE #shorts
description:
Episode 8 of MICROWAVE MAGIC✨a series where I make your favourite desserts at home only in a microwave 🙌🏻 There can never be too many chocolate cake recipes…but this one is a must-try🍫Made in just 5 minutes, this Chocolate Tiffin Cake is soft, moist and the easiest way to satisfy your dessert cravings 🥰

Ingredients 
1/2 cup yogurt
1/4 tsp baking soda
3/4 cup caster sugar
6 tbsp sunflower oil
1/4 cup milk 
3/4 cup all purpose flour 
6 tbsp cocoa powder
1/2 tsp baking powder 
1 bar of chocolate

Method

1. In a bowl, combine yogurt/dahi and baking soda. Let it rest for a minute and you’ll see that the mixture will become voluminous.
⁠2. Now add in the sugar sunflower oil and milk in the same bowl and whisk until combined.
3. Sift in the dry ingredients- all purpose flour, cocoa powder and baking powder. Mix everything together to form a lump free batter. Do not overmix at this stage.
4. Transfer the batter into a 
 rectangular glass dish and bake in microwave at regular heating mode for 3 minutes.
5. Once the cake is out of the microwave, place an entire bar of dark chocolate on top of the cake and heat in a microwave at regular settings for about 2 mins, till the chocolate just begins to melt.
